name: Tripod Stand with Wire Gauze & China Dish
semanticDescription: Laboratory heating assembly comprising a heavy cast-iron triangular tripod stand, nichrome wire gauze with ceramic heat-distribution center pad, and porcelain evaporating china dish containing copper powder undergoing thermal oxidation into black copper(II) oxide (CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Ch 1 Activity 1.11).
simplifications: Wire mesh modeled as textured nichrome grid with ceramic refractory heat-distribution disc and surface copper oxide crust cross-section.
